seller_history: Acquired the catalog from Vermillion Music Publishing in November 2017.
offered: 100% worldwide publishing on 32 compositions across three Hollow Verge albums - Soft Static (1998, 10), Pale Engines (2001, 11), The Migrant Hour (2005, 11) - plus Northbridge's interest in the masters of Pale Engines and The Migrant Hour, and accrued income through closing.
excluded: Ordinary Weather (2010, band-owned); Japanese B-sides EP / Night Sounds (reverted to Asahi Editions, 2018).
